description: Make or change a saved board view, as the board's «Save as view» does. Name the view by 'id' to change it (a new 'name' renames it) or by 'name' alone: an existing view of that name (any case) is changed, otherwise a new one is made. What you leave out of a change keeps its value; a new view starts with no labels and leaves every filter as the reader has it. 'only' / 'hide' are labels; a label in both is hidden. 'assignee' and 'sprint' are the board's own filter values ('__all__' for all, a sprint's id, a person's display name) and 'jql' its JQL box — pass '' to clear one back to «leave the reader's». Every change is a line in the project's journal under your name. Only the project's lead or an administrator may keep views, and not while the project is paused or archived; at most 30 a board, names up to 80 characters, one per name.

assignee.description: The board's assignee filter: '__all__', or a person's display name. '' — leave the reader's.

id.description: The view to change, by id (from list_board_views). Leave out to find it by 'name' or make it.

jql.description: The board's JQL box, ANDed onto the board. '' — leave the reader's.

name.description: The view's name — «Specs». With 'id', its new name.

sprint.description: The board's sprint filter: '__all__', or a sprint's id. '' — leave the reader's.

withWork.description: Whether an epic's label reaches its stories and sub-tasks.
